title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**Who are we?**
---------------

Kapture CX is an AI-native, verticalized SaaS platform helping enterprises automate and execute complex customer and business workflows.

At the core of Kapture is AgentOS — our Agentic Operating System that brings together AI agents, human intelligence, enterprise systems, and operational intelligence to execute work end-to-end. AgentOS enables enterprises to build, deploy, orchestrate, monitor, evaluate, and optimize AI-powered workflows across customer support, sales, collections, claims, and other business operations.

Today, Kapture is trusted by 1,000+ enterprises across 18 countries, helping organizations move beyond isolated automation toward intelligent, outcome-driven operations.

### **What is this role all about?**

We are looking for a driven and enthusiastic **Talent Acquisition Specialist** who is passionate about finding great talent and building high-performing teams.

You will play a key role in driving end-to-end recruitment, partnering with business stakeholders, identifying exceptional talent, and ensuring a seamless hiring experience. If you enjoy the thrill of closing challenging positions, exploring creative sourcing strategies, and connecting the right people with the right opportunities, this role is for you!

### **Sounds interesting?**

### **Here is what you will be doing:**

* Drive end-to-end recruitment across technical and non-technical functions, from requirement understanding to offer rollout and successful onboarding.
* Partner closely with hiring managers to understand business requirements, define candidate profiles, and align on hiring priorities.
* Build effective sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, referrals, job portals, and other innovative channels.
* Conduct initial candidate assessments and evaluate profiles based on relevant experience, technical competencies, and role suitability.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines through proactive sourcing, market mapping, and continuous candidate engagement.
* Manage interview coordination, stakeholder follow-ups, feedback tracking, and candidate communication throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* Drive offer management, compensation discussions, negotiation, and candidate engagement to improve offer-to-joining ratios.
* Maintain recruitment trackers, hiring dashboards, and key recruitment metrics to ensure effective reporting and pipeline management.

### **What does success look like?**

* Successfully managing and closing assigned recruitment mandates within defined timelines.
* Building a consistent pipeline of quality candidates across multiple functions.
* Maintaining strong relationships with hiring managers and business stakeholders.
* Delivering a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
* Improving hiring efficiency through effective sourcing strategies and proactive pipeline management.

### **What would make you a good fit?**

**Basic Requirements:**

* 2–3 years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment.
* Hands-on experience in managing end-to-end recruitment processes.
* Exposure to hiring across technical and non-technical roles.
* Good understanding of recruitment lifecycle, candidate assessment, and offer management.

**Most Critical Skills:**

* Strong sourcing and candidate identification skills.
* Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri, and other recruitment platforms.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple hiring mandates in a fast-paced environment.

**Advantage if you have:**

* Experience working in a SaaS, IT, or product-based organization.
* Exposure to hiring for Engineering, Product, AI/ML, Sales, and Customer Success roles.
* Experience in talent mapping, niche hiring, and proactive headhunting.
* Familiarity with ATS platforms, recruitment dashboards, and hiring analytics.

### **Why should you be interested?**

* **Ownership:** Get the opportunity to independently manage recruitment mandates and drive hiring outcomes.
* **Learning:** Gain exposure to diverse business functions, technology roles, and leadership hiring.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with business leaders and hiring managers across the organization.
* **Growth:** Be part of a growing organization where your contribution directly impacts team building and business growth.

### **Does this sound like you?**

If you are someone who loves connecting with people, spotting great talent, enjoys a good hiring challenge, and believes that great teams build great businesses, we would love to hear from you!

**Click the Apply button to let us know!**

description:
**About the Role**  
  
As an Engineering Manager at Uber, you will lead a team of engineers and engineering managers in the development of global solutions, collaborating closely with product managers, data scientists, and other engineering teams.  
  
This role, within the Bangalore-based Payments organization (Disbursements Processing), entails leading, mentoring, and managing a high-performing, diverse team. This organization aims to leverage Payments as a competitive advantage by optimizing the paying and payment processes for both users and the business.  
  
The Disbursements Processing team manages global earner payouts, encompassing the following responsibilities:  

* Collaboration with over 20+ global external partners to facilitate worldwide earner payments.
* Ensuring a reliable and consistent payout experience.
* Developing and managing a scalable engineering platform with continuous enhancements.
* Guaranteeing reliable weekly payments for 10 million earners globally.

  
- What the Candidate Will Do -  
Lead a 10-person engineering team and be responsible for:  

* Ideating, developing, and delivering payment product platforms.
* Operational and engineering excellence initiatives.
* Career growth within the organization by developing Staff-level individual contributors.
* Creating organizational and cross-organizational impact by designing, iterating on, and delivering processes that support Uber engineering.
* Partnering with diverse roles and individuals across various disciplines such as product management, talent acquisition, data science, and product design, spanning from fresh graduates to experienced professionals.

  
- Basic Qualifications -  

* Experience in engineering management (4+ years), demonstrating the ability to manage a larger team
* Skilled in guiding, mentoring, and coaching technically proficient teams, leveraging technical expertise and analytical abilities. Able to architect and design robust, high-scale systems, encouraging engineers to think broadly and generically in their solutions.
* Knowledgeable in large-scale distributed systems, SQL/NoSQL storage, cloud services (AWS, GCP, OCI), transactional updates, asynchronous processing (Kafka), logging, monitoring, observability, and performance tuning.
* Experienced in working with globally distributed, cross-functional teams, coordinating efforts to deliver multi-area solutions.
* Proficient in cross-functional collaboration, influencing PMs, designers, data scientists, and upstream business/infrastructure teams to identify, prioritize, and solve problems.
* Proven ability to grow teams, recruit/retain strong engineering leaders, and manage performance.
* Familiar with client-side architecture for large native mobile and web platform teams, covering dependency management, feature flagging, UI trade-offs, and funnel design.
* Adaptable to a strong, reliability-focused engineering culture while prioritizing business stakeholder value. Possesses self-learning capabilities, strong time management for scaling, precise communication, and strong collaborative traits.

  
- Preferred Qualifications -  

* Experience with payments, including understanding global and regional nuances.
* Proven ability to execute complex initiatives, delivering resilient, high-performing systems on time and meeting business goals and user needs.
* Background in product experimentation, including statistical knowledge, experimentation mechanics, and analysis skills to interpret, debug, and challenge experimental results.

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

Legacy GRC runs on spreadsheets, screenshots, and an annual scramble to prove that controls worked months ago. **The Experience**  
  
We are seeking a lead full stack engineer with enterprise software engineering experience to drive the architecture, technical roadmap, and execution for our next-generation Security Assurance Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform. In this role, you will hold end-to-end technical ownership over the platform’s core engines—including policy as code, compliance as code, automated evidence collection, telemetry and alerting, and risk evaluation modules.
  
  
Beyond hands-on development in Python, Java, and modern front-end frameworks, you will act as a primary technical leader: defining system architecture, scoping and planning multi-quarter technical initiatives, and guiding distributed feature teams from concept through deployment. You will also pioneer the team’s operational strategy around AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) to accelerate output and elevate code quality across the engineering organization.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* End-to-End Ownership: Take technical ownership of complex, multi-system initiatives, driving architectural decisions, technical specifications, phase planning, and execution across the delivery lifecycle.

* Roadmap & Project Planning: Partner with Product Management, Security Architects, and GRC leaders to translate broad business and regulatory strategies into detailed technical roadmaps, milestones, and sprint backlogs.
* Technical Governance: Establish engineering standards, perform high-impact code and architecture reviews, enforce secure coding guidelines, and institute rigorous CI/CD and testing benchmarks across the engineering org.
* Policy & Governance as Code: Design and implement extensible Policy as Code and Compliance as Code engines (e.g., leveraging Open Policy Agent/OPA or custom evaluation frameworks) and runtime platforms (e.g. CSPM, EDR, etc) that dynamically audit infrastructure and enterprise controls. Constrain the outputs of AI coding assistants with declarative machine-readable rules.
* Automated Evidence Collection: Lead the design of automated evidence collection pipelines integrating with multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), identity providers, enterprise security tools, CI/CD pipelines, ticketing systems, and productivity / corporate applications (Workday, Netsuite, etc).
* Risk & Regulatory Modeling: Build dynamic risk analysis engines and auditing interfaces capable of mapping continuous technical evidence against major regulatory standards (NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2).
* AI-Assisted Engineering: Lead the adoption and integration of AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude, Gemini, OpenAI APIs) across the engineering lifecycle to optimize team productivity, automate test generation, and streamline refactoring.
* Mentorship: Actively mentor senior and mid-level engineers across time zones, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning.
Lead cross-functional alignment and technical discussions across a geographically dispersed team operating in an asynchronous-first culture.  

**You're Our Person If...**

* Experience: 6–13 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience, including 3+ years at the Senior Member of Technical Staff (SMTS) or Lead Member of Technical Staff (LMTS) level leading technical projects and distributed engineering teams.

* AI Tooling & Innovation: Advanced proficiency in leveraging AI coding assistants (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery, paired with a strategic vision for integrating AI into technical workflows.
* Data & Cloud Systems: Strong expertise in relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL/graph databases, distributed data processing, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Regulatory Frameworks: Working knowledge of regulatory standards including NIST SP 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2 (Trust Services Criteria).
